		set_variable = { name = zg361_wad_offer_source_pending value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_wad_offer_source_consumed value = 1 } # source consume commit last
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_ad_source_status value = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ad_owner SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ad_subject

				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ad_state ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ad_active

			}

			has_variable = zg361_wad_offer_source_consumed
			has_variable = zg361_wad_offer_source_retired

			has_variable = zg361_wad_offer_source_subject
			has_variable = zg361_wad_offer_source_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_wad_offer_source_case
			has_variable = zg361_wad_offer_source_state
			has_variable = zg361_wad_offer_source_id
			has_variable = zg361_wad_offer_source_hash
			has_variable = zg361_wad_offer_source_response

			var:zg361_wad_offer_source_consumed = 1
			var:zg361_wad_offer_source_retired = 0

			has_variable = zg361_we_m275_object_subject

			has_variable = zg361_we_m275_object_state

zg361_we_retire_referral_source_after_m267_debt_effect = {
	remove_variable = zg361_we_ad_source_status
	remove_variable = zg361_we_ad_source_red_code
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = zg361_wad_referral_source_id
			has_variable = zg361_wad_referral_source_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_wad_referral_source_case
			has_variable = zg361_wad_referral_source_disposition
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = zg361_we_ad_expected_referral_source_hash
			value = { value = var:zg361_wad_referral_source_id multiply = 1000000 add = { value = var:zg361_wad_referral_source_cycle multiply = 10000 } add = { value = var:zg361_wad_referral_source_case multiply = 10 } add = var:zg361_wad_referral_source_disposition }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ad_owner SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ad_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ad_cycle_serial CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ad_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ad_state ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ad_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$ EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$ EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$ EXPECTED_STATE = 1
			}
			has_variable = zg361_wad_referral_source_pending
			has_variable = zg361_wad_referral_source_consumed
			has_variable = zg361_wad_referral_source_retired
			has_variable = zg361_wad_referral_source_owner
			has_variable = zg361_wad_referral_source_subject
			has_variable = zg361_wad_referral_source_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_wad_referral_source_case
			has_variable = zg361_wad_referral_source_state
			has_variable = zg361_wad_referral_source_id
			has_variable = zg361_wad_referral_source_hash
			has_variable = zg361_wad_referral_source_disposition
			var:zg361_wad_referral_source_pending = 1
			var:zg361_wad_referral_source_consumed = 0
			var:zg361_wad_referral_source_retired = 0
			var:zg361_wad_referral_source_owner = $TICKET_OWNER$
			var:zg361_wad_referral_source_subject = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
			var:zg361_wad_referral_source_cycle = $TICKET_CYCLE$
			var:zg361_wad_referral_source_case = $TICKET_CASE$
			var:zg361_wad_referral_source_state = 1
			var:zg361_wad_referral_source_id > 0
			var:zg361_wad_referral_source_hash = scope:zg361_we_ad_expected_referral_source_hash
			OR = { var:zg361_wad_referral_source_disposition = 1 var:zg361_wad_referral_source_disposition = 2 var:zg361_wad_referral_source_disposition = 3 }
			has_variable = zg361_we_m267_business_object_created
			has_variable = zg361_we_m267_choice
			has_variable = zg361_we_m267_debt_owner
			has_variable = zg361_we_m267_debt_subject
			has_variable = zg361_we_m267_debt_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_we_m267_debt_case
			has_variable = zg361_we_m267_debt_state
			has_variable = zg361_we_m267_debt_open
			has_variable = zg361_we_m267_debt_consumed
			has_variable = zg361_we_m267_debt_visible_to_settlement
			has_variable = zg361_we_m267_consumed_owner
			has_variable = zg361_we_m267_consumed_subject
			has_variable = zg361_we_m267_consumed_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_we_m267_consumed_case
			has_variable = zg361_we_m267_consumed_state
			var:zg361_we_m267_business_object_created = 0
			var:zg361_we_m267_choice = 3
			var:zg361_we_m267_debt_owner = $TICKET_OWNER$
			var:zg361_we_m267_debt_subject = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
			var:zg361_we_m267_debt_cycle = $TICKET_CYCLE$
			var:zg361_we_m267_debt_case = $TICKET_CASE$
			var:zg361_we_m267_debt_state = 1
			var:zg361_we_m267_debt_open = 1
			var:zg361_we_m267_debt_consumed = 0
			var:zg361_we_m267_debt_visible_to_settlement = 1
			var:zg361_we_m267_consumed_owner = $TICKET_OWNER$
			var:zg361_we_m267_consumed_subject = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
			var:zg361_we_m267_consumed_cycle = $TICKET_CYCLE$
			var:zg361_we_m267_consumed_case = $TICKET_CASE$
			var:zg361_we_m267_consumed_state = 1
			zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
				RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_we_m267_receipt_owner
				RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_we_m267_receipt_subject
				RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_we_m267_receipt_cycle
				RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_we_m267_receipt_case
				RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_we_m267_receipt_state
				RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_we_m267_receipt_choice
				EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
				EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
				EXPECTED_STATE = 1
				EXPECTED_CHOICE = 3
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_referral_source_retired_id value = var:zg361_wad_referral_source_id }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_referral_source_retired_hash value = var:zg361_wad_referral_source_hash }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_wad_referral_source_pending value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_wad_referral_source_retired value = 1 } # never marks consumed
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_ad_source_status value = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = zg361_wad_referral_source_pending
			has_variable = zg361_wad_referral_source_consumed
			has_variable = zg361_wad_referral_source_retired
			has_variable = zg361_wad_referral_source_owner
			has_variable = zg361_wad_referral_source_subject
			has_variable = zg361_wad_referral_source_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_wad_referral_source_case
			has_variable = zg361_wad_referral_source_state
			has_variable = zg361_wad_referral_source_id
			has_variable = zg361_wad_referral_source_hash
			has_variable = zg361_wad_referral_source_disposition
			var:zg361_wad_referral_source_pending = 0
			var:zg361_wad_referral_source_consumed = 0
			var:zg361_wad_referral_source_retired = 1
			var:zg361_wad_referral_source_owner = $TICKET_OWNER$
			var:zg361_wad_referral_source_subject = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
			var:zg361_wad_referral_source_cycle = $TICKET_CYCLE$
			var:zg361_wad_referral_source_case = $TICKET_CASE$
			var:zg361_wad_referral_source_state = 1
			var:zg361_wad_referral_source_id > 0
			var:zg361_wad_referral_source_hash = scope:zg361_we_ad_expected_referral_source_hash
			OR = { var:zg361_wad_referral_source_disposition = 1 var:zg361_wad_referral_source_disposition = 2 var:zg361_wad_referral_source_disposition = 3 }
			has_variable = zg361_we_referral_source_retired_id
			has_variable = zg361_we_referral_source_retired_hash
			var:zg361_we_referral_source_retired_id = var:zg361_wad_referral_source_id
			var:zg361_we_referral_source_retired_hash = var:zg361_wad_referral_source_hash
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_ad_source_status value = 2 }
	}
	else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_we_ad_source_status value = 3 } }
}

			var:zg361_we_m267_debt_case = $TICKET_CASE$

			var:zg361_we_m267_debt_open = 1
			var:zg361_we_m267_debt_consumed = 0

				RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_we_m267_receipt_owner

				EXPECTED_CHOICE = 3
			}
		}

# An authorised AI manager cannot display the remaining AD windows after
# a typed referral/panel N/A.  Continue the exact tuple with route C at every
# later stage; these debt routes never consume a real actor source.

	if = {
		limit = {
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ad_owner SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ad_subject

			}
			$TICKET_OWNER$ = { is_ai = yes zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes }
		}
		zg361_we_m268_route_c_effect = { TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$ TICKET_SUBJECT = this TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$ TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$ TICKET_STATE = 2 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = zg361_we_runtime_applied var:zg361_we_runtime_applied = 1 }
			zg361_we_m270_route_c_effect = { TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$ TICKET_SUBJECT = this TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$ TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$ TICKET_STATE = 2 }
		}

			limit = { has_variable = zg361_we_runtime_applied var:zg361_we_runtime_applied = 1 var:zg361_case_ad_state = 3 }

# A human candidate may refuse an AI manager's offer.  #274-B records the
# rejection, then this exact-tuple continuation records #275 before closing
# the no-hire-only tail.  The pending offer is consumed only by successful
# #275 A/B, never by #274-B itself.
zg361_we_continue_ai_ad_after_offer_refusal_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ad_owner SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ad_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ad_cycle_serial CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ad_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ad_state ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ad_active

				EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$ EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$ EXPECTED_STATE = 4
			}
			$TICKET_OWNER$ = { is_ai = yes zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = zg361_we_m267_runner_up_present var:zg361_we_m267_runner_up_present = 1 }
			zg361_we_m275_route_a_effect = { TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$ TICKET_SUBJECT = this TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$ TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$ }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_variable = zg361_we_m267_runner_up_present var:zg361_we_m267_runner_up_present = 0 }
			zg361_we_m275_route_b_effect = { TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$ TICKET_SUBJECT = this TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$ TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$ }
		}

			limit = { has_variable = zg361_we_runtime_applied var:zg361_we_runtime_applied = 1 var:zg361_case_ad_state = 5 }

		}
		if = {

			zg361_we_m276_route_c_effect = { TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$ TICKET_SUBJECT = this TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$ TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$ TICKET_STATE = 6 }

# Product callbacks: WAIT never advances; READY resumes the exact tuple;
# typed N/A records only route-C debt and retires (never consumes) its source.
zg361_we_resume_m271_from_referral_source_effect = {
	remove_variable = zg361_we_ad_source_status
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = zg361_wad_referral_source_id
			has_variable = zg361_wad_referral_source_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_wad_referral_source_case
			has_variable = zg361_wad_referral_source_disposition
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = zg361_we_ad_expected_referral_source_hash
			value = { value = var:zg361_wad_referral_source_id multiply = 1000000 add = { value = var:zg361_wad_referral_source_cycle multiply = 10000 } add = { value = var:zg361_wad_referral_source_case multiply = 10 } add = var:zg361_wad_referral_source_disposition }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ad_owner SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ad_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ad_cycle_serial CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ad_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ad_state ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ad_active

				EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$ EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$ EXPECTED_STATE = 1
			}
			has_variable = zg361_wad_referral_source_pending
			has_variable = zg361_wad_referral_source_consumed

			has_variable = zg361_wad_referral_source_cycle

			has_variable = zg361_wad_referral_source_state
			has_variable = zg361_wad_referral_source_id

			has_variable = zg361_wad_referral_source_disposition

			var:zg361_wad_referral_source_disposition = 1
			has_variable = zg361_wad_referral_source_referral_id
			has_variable = zg361_wad_referral_source_referrer
			has_variable = zg361_wad_referral_source_relationship
			has_variable = zg361_wad_referral_source_evidence_receipt
			var:zg361_wad_referral_source_referral_id > 0
			var:zg361_wad_referral_source_evidence_receipt > 0
			NOT = { var:zg361_wad_referral_source_id = var:zg361_wad_referral_source_referral_id }
			NOT = { var:zg361_wad_referral_source_id = var:zg361_wad_referral_source_evidence_receipt }
			NOT = { var:zg361_wad_referral_source_referral_id = var:zg361_wad_referral_source_evidence_receipt }
			var:zg361_wad_referral_source_referrer = { zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes }
			NOT = { var:zg361_wad_referral_source_referrer = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
			var:zg361_wad_referral_source_relationship >= 1
			var:zg361_wad_referral_source_relationship <= 3
		}
		if = {
			limit = { $TICKET_OWNER$ = { is_ai = yes } }
			zg361_we_m271_route_a_effect = { TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$ TICKET_SUBJECT = this TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$ TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$ }
		}
		else = {
			save_scope_as = zg361_we_ad_subject
			$TICKET_OWNER$ = { save_scope_as = zg361_we_ad_owner }
			save_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_we_ad_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
			save_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_we_ad_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
			$TICKET_OWNER$ = { trigger_event = { id = zg361we.271 } }
		}

	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ad_owner SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ad_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ad_cycle_serial CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ad_case_serial

			has_variable = zg361_wad_referral_source_consumed
			has_variable = zg361_wad_referral_source_retired
			has_variable = zg361_wad_referral_source_owner
			has_variable = zg361_wad_referral_source_subject
			has_variable = zg361_wad_referral_source_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_wad_referral_source_case
			has_variable = zg361_wad_referral_source_state
			has_variable = zg361_wad_referral_source_id

			var:zg361_wad_referral_source_state = 1
			var:zg361_wad_referral_source_id > 0

}
